newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Super Coffeemix in vending machines.
newsitem.headline: Super Coffeemix in vending machines.

text.p: Super Coffeemix Manufacturing Ltd said on Tuesday it agreed to subscribe for 70 percent or 315,000 shares of Super Vending Pte Ltd (SVPL).
The company said in a statement SVPL would be used as an investment holding vehicle for vending machine operations.
About 20 percent of the remaining shares would be held by Tan Song Koon while the other 10 percent by Low Kuei Hsiang.
It added SVPL would acquire 440,000 shares or 55 percent stake in vending machine service provider, Multi-Vending Pte Ltd, for Singapore $420,200.
